papers.title: Parton distribution functions from lattice QCD
papers.review_summary: This invited chapter reviews the theoretical foundations and current status of lattice-QCD calculations of PDFs, emphasizing modern approaches based on spatially nonlocal matrix elements. It summarizes selected lattice results for proton, pion, and kaon PDFs, gluon PDFs, and twist-3 distributions.
evidence: Invited chapter to the Encyclopedia of Nuclear Physics
Summarizes selected lattice results for proton, pion, kaon, gluon, and twist-3
Emphasis on spatially nonlocal matrix elements and large-momentum effective theory

papers.title: First constraints on the nonperturbative gluon Collins-Soper kernel
papers.review_summary: This paper presents the first nonperturbative constraints on the gluon Collins-Soper kernel from lattice QCD. It utilizes Large-Momentum Effective Theory with next-to-next-to-leading logarithmic matching to analyze boosted pion matrix elements.

papers.title: Baryon Light-Cone Distribution Amplitudes from Lattice QCD: Formalism, Renormalization, Extrapolation, and Matching
papers.review_summary: This paper presents a systematic LaMET framework for determining baryon leading-twist light-cone distribution amplitudes (LCDAs) from lattice QCD, including hybrid renormalization and large-distance extrapolation. It provides a numerical demonstration of the complete pipeline applied to the Lambda-baryon A-structure LCDA using seven 2+1-flavor lattice ensembles.

papers.title: Complete Access to Leading-Twist $Λ$-Baryon Light-Cone Distribution Amplitudes from Lattice QCD
papers.review_summary: This paper presents the first complete lattice-QCD determination of leading-twist Λ-baryon light-cone distribution amplitudes using LaMET. It provides full two-dimensional functions of valence-quark momentum fractions, validated by phenomenological applications to electromagnetic form factors.
evidence: Continuum and physical pion mass extrapolations performed

papers.title: Direct calculation of parton distributions in momentum space from lattice QCD
papers.review_summary: This paper proposes a direct momentum-space calculation of Coulomb-gauge quasi-parton distributions, removing the formal inverse problem in Fourier transforms. It validates this method against traditional coordinate-space LaMET results for pion valence PDFs and presents the first direct 3D image of the pion from lattice QCD.
evidence: Coulomb-gauge quasi-PDFs computed directly in momentum space
Pion valence PDFs at m_pi ~ 310 MeV
First direct 3D image of the pion

papers.title: Hybrid renormalization in lattice calculation of baryon LCDAs
papers.review_summary: This paper reviews the implementation of a hybrid renormalization scheme for octet baryon quasi-distribution amplitudes (quasi-DAs) within the LaMET framework. It details the removal of linear divergences and the connection to the MS-bar scheme using Nf=2+1 lattice ensembles.
evidence: Nf=2+1 ensembles with stout-smeared clover fermions

papers.title: Determination of heavy meson light-cone distribution amplitudes: theoretical framework and lattice simulations
papers.review_summary: This paper synthesizes the theoretical framework and lattice simulation results for heavy meson light-cone distribution amplitudes (LCDAs) using the heavy-quark large-momentum effective theory (HQLaMET). It details the determination of both QCD and HQET LCDAs from six gauge ensembles, validating the results against operator product expansion moments.

papers.title: Hybrid Renormalization for Baryon Distribution Amplitudes from Lattice QCD in LaMET
papers.review_summary: This paper reviews the implementation of a hybrid renormalization scheme for octet baryon quasi-distribution amplitudes within the LaMET framework. It demonstrates that this method effectively removes linear divergences and provides reliable results for light-baryon LCDAs across perturbative and non-perturbative regions.
evidence: CLQCD ensembles with stout-smeared clover fermions
